name: Volume Rendering Equation with Extinction and Inscattering
definition: A physically accurate volume rendering model that accounts for light attenuation (absorption and out-scattering) and light gain (emission and in-scattering) by integrating over the sphere of directions, replacing the simplified single-light-source approximation.
summary: This method computes camera radiance by integrating light attenuation and gain along a ray, distinguishing itself by including scattering effects and integrating over the full sphere of directions.
